recognize_zh: 這是一張教學示意圖，而非形態學影像：分三欄整理 ET 與 PV 的血栓表現，分別以腦部 CT、腫脹發紅的下肢與手掌紅斑配合條列文字，說明動脈血栓、靜脈血栓與微循環障礙（如紅斑性肢痛症 erythromelalgia）。
features: Three-panel schematic summarizing thrombotic complications of essential thrombocythemia and polycythemia vera
Arterial thrombosis panel: head CT with a hypodense territory, listing MI, unstable angina, stroke, TIA, peripheral embolism
Venous thrombosis panel: swollen erythematous limb, listing DVT, PE, splanchnic and cerebral sinus thrombosis, superficial thrombophlebitis
Microcirculatory panel: erythematous palms and fingers (erythromelalgia), listing seizures, migraine, vertigo, tinnitus, scotomas, amaurosis fugax
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic educational figure summarizing the spectrum of thrombosis in essential thrombocythemia and polycythemia vera. It groups manifestations into arterial thrombosis (illustrated by a head CT with an ischemic territory), venous thrombosis including unusual sites such as splanchnic and cerebral sinus veins (illustrated by a swollen erythematous limb), and microcirculatory disturbances such as erythromelalgia (illustrated by erythematous palms). The practical point is that unexplained splanchnic vein thrombosis or erythromelalgia should prompt a blood count and JAK2 V617F/CALR testing, and that aspirin-responsive microvascular symptoms are characteristic of MPN-related thrombocytosis.
